description: Cities:Skylines-inspired road/path builder INPUT layer: straight/curved/freeform drag-to-place segments with continuous chaining, 45/90-degree angle snapping, alignment guidelines, ghost preview with validity coloring, snap-to-existing-path (coordinate-sharing only, no topology), live metric length readout, and a path_kind designed|recorded provenance property — all on the existing gpx_points + path_asset stamping model via the PathOp -> DbCommand seam
notes:
ROUND 4 OQ RESOLUTIONS (2026-11-13, turn4-plan §9 defaults accepted at launch): OQ-1 road hotkey L (B is Brush; A/D are camera fly keys); OQ-2 snap radius is world-space, default 3 m (screen-space only if far-zoom snapping proves grabby in in-app review); OQ-3 first-commit track named 'Road N'; OQ-4 both (per round-4 steer; see the road-builder section of fe-ui/src/node_manager/AGENTS.md for the recorded default). Chosen as defaults, not user-confirmed. User-ratified HYBRID decision 2026-07-16 (C:S screenshot as reference feel): input layer ONLY. Non-goals deferred to named follow-on 'procedural_roads' (not created): ribbon road meshes, auto intersections/junction topology, road upgrade tool, zoning. Runs parallel with mcp_scene_primitives_20260716 and map_scale_authority_20260716 — stays in fe-ui + fractalengine/gpx_bridge; CONSUMES (not defines) the world_scale accessor via a single metric_scale() seam, feature-detected with world-unit degrade. Key decisions: curved mode = three-click quadratic Bezier reusing curve::bezier's 3-point promotion (no new curve math); snapped endpoints share coordinates only (documented limitation feeding procedural_roads); path_kind flat property, absence => recorded (zero migration); ghost/guides via immediate-mode Gizmos; snap candidates from resident TrackPickShape polylines; new Tool::Road (hotkey B) + ClickPriority::RoadPlace; multi-point commits reuse UiAction::PathAppendShape; first-commit auto-create mirrors pen correlation-id deferred flush (road-track:N). depends_on listed tracks are LANDED (consumed as foundations, not blockers).
VALIDATED 2026-07-19: pending (confirmed) — zero implementation evidence: no road_snap.rs, no Tool::Road/RoadPlace, no path_kind property writes anywhere in fe-ui/src or fractalengine/src (only unrelated hit was a pre-existing `is_path_selection_matches_only_path_kinds` test in selection.rs, coincidental name match, not this track). depends_on foundations (path_interaction_20260716, gpx_stamp_persistence_20260716) confirmed landed per spec's own Background section. remaining: all 5 phases (pure snap core, path_kind provenance, tool/routing wiring, ghost/UX, hardening+sweep) — not started.
COORDINATE-WITH 2026-07-24: the new Tool::Road input dispatch (Phase 3 tool/routing wiring, ClickPriority::RoadPlace) must ride ui_shell_architecture_20260724's pointer-ops manager rather than adding another parallel click path — sequence Phase 3 after (or with) that track's pointer-ops seam.
